name: World Logic Trauma NeoForge RC20 — component regression

steps.name: TR-STATE: seven healthy zones, localized damage, NBT roundtrip
TR-TREAT: reject healthy target, bilateral arm and leg splints, gradual recovery
TR-BRIDGE: core injury predicate, penalty, arm signal, legacy migration
TR-DAMAGE: fall damage, unaffected head, creative exclusion
TR-API: public rule and fatigue API, recovery, creative mode, invalid input
TR-PROCEDURE: immediate cursor consumption, duplicate and invalid rejection, cursor independence, explicit cancellation
TR-TARGETING: trauma kit bleed priority, medkit living tissue and no-effect rejection
Precise emergency grace persistence and invalid local HP safeguards
TR-IDENTITY: branded loader identity, mandatory core, preserved medical item IDs and save key
TR-THERMAL: optional provider guard, valid stage, scaled recovery and no thermal mutation
TR-RESPAWN: healthy first join, death reset persisted, relog and nondeath clone preserve injury
TR-BLOODLOSS: weak and severe systemic loss, nonbleeding black limb, local bleeding and vital destruction
TR-PHYSIOLOGY: independent limb function, splint benefit, pain relief, blood volume, shock, persistence and reset
TR-WOUNDS: classification, persistence, primitive treatments, retired recipes and stable registry
TR-PRIMITIVE: herb workpiece placement, cell processing, partial resume, drop, canonical treatment roles
TR-PUBLICAPI: immutable seven-region snapshot, external injury, invalid input and creative guards
TR-CLIMB: full block ascent, arm selection, duration, headroom and interrupted path
TR-OWNERSHIP: registered damage event and Trauma API remain active with Core legacy injuries disabled
TR-FROST-COMPAT: legacy local exposure at -17 C, modern API ownership, vanilla freeze and insulation
TR-WATER-ILLNESS: dose, incubation, symptoms, treatment, recovery, persistence, illness-only loss
